items.title: Freeze F-009 target proof scope
items.context: Record current main HEAD/materialHash, selected clean .lattice artifact root, suiteRunId, and F-009 finding snapshot before any proof attempt.
items.userSees: User sees 'F-009 target frozen' with current HEAD, materialHash, suiteRunId, clean .lattice artifact root, and finding snapshot path.

happy.desc: The frozen scope evidence records current main/story HEAD, materialHash, suiteRunId, clean .lattice artifact root, and F-009 finding snapshot.

edge.desc: The selected artifact root is under .lattice and is clean/isolated from stale default baseline artifacts.

adversarial.desc: The frozen scope explicitly excludes .omx and does not allow disabled legacy roots or mixed stale proof roots.

verificationEvidence.command: lattice finding_list --storyId=B-META-framework-audit; git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse main; material hash computed from currentMaterialHash algorithm
verificationEvidence.note: Freeze records story/main HEADs, materialHash a9b5b195002e575ca00cad762701c686b3f89047071497c4bb3cbcf547b98c1c, suiteRunId f009-layer2-closure-20260612T161654Z, artifactRoot, and F-009 snapshot.
Precheck showed artifactRoot did not exist before proof diagnostics, so stale default artifacts were isolated from the frozen proof root.

verificationEvidence.command: lattice baseline_suite_report/capability_claim_formal_evaluate with .lattice artifact root; no omx commands or paths used
verificationEvidence.note: Freeze explicitly excludes .omx and binds proof work to .lattice/artifacts/baseline/f009-layer2-closure-20260612T161654Z only.

items.title: Run formal Layer 2 proof and negative controls
items.context: Generate or verify fresh Development proof, 9 ENG final reports, Engineering suite report, formal claim evaluator output, and fail-closed controls for local-only/stale/forged/wrong-target artifacts.
items.userSees: User sees 'Layer 2 formal claim: LOCKED/BLOCKED with explicit reasons' or 'Layer 2 formal claim: UNLOCKED; higher layers remain LOCKED'.

happy.desc: Formal proof commands run against the frozen clean artifact root and produce a clear Engineering suite and claim evaluator result.
Requirements NAV count and links match the actual decisions markdown files after any scope hygiene repair.

edge.desc: If fresh Development proof or any of the 9 ENG final reports are missing, the suite/evaluator remains LOCKED or BLOCKED with explicit reasons.

adversarial.desc: Local-only, stale, forged, wrong-target, wrong-suiteRunId, and Authority-overclaim artifacts fail closed and cannot unlock Layer 2.

verificationEvidence.note: Formal diagnostics ran against frozen clean root; suite report is BLOCKED and formal claim report is LOCKED with explicit missing Development and Engineering proof reasons.
Missing fresh Development proof and all 9 ENG final reports kept suiteStatus=BLOCKED, authorization=not_authorized, formalProof=false, falseDoneCount=0.

items.title: Collect two-host verdicts and close or retain F-009
items.context: Use Claude CLI and Codex CLI host verdicts as localNonAuthorityAudit only. Resolve F-009 only if evidence proves it; otherwise keep it open or mark verified with exact missing work.
items.userSees: User sees 'F-009 final status: RESOLVED' or 'F-009 final status: REMAINS OPEN/VERIFIED with missing proof listed', with Claude/Codex localNonAuthorityAudit refs.

happy.desc: Claude and Codex host verdicts review the same frozen artifact root, suiteRunId, HEAD, materialHash, and F-009 evidence anchors.

edge.desc: If evidence is insufficient, F-009 is not falsely resolved; final status says open or verified with exact missing proof.

adversarial.desc: Final status does not claim receiptVerified, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, Layer 3, Production Safety, or global capability from local host evidence.
